cards.text: Jehoshaphat, king of Judah, has an abundance of riches and honor, and he's allied himself with Ahab, king of Israel, by marriage. Some years later he goes down to visit Ahab in Samaria, and Ahab sacrifices many sheep and cattle for him and everyone with him. Friend, when I landed in the Millers' junk drawer, my whole welcome was a dead battery rolling over.

cards.question: In the middle of all that welcome, Ahab starts urging Jehoshaphat to march up against a city. Which one?

cards.text: Then Ahab asks him flat out, "Will you go with me against Ramoth-gilead?" Now Jehoshaphat has to answer.

cards.question: True or false: Jehoshaphat tells Ahab that Judah will stay out of the war against Ramoth-gilead.

cards.text: Jehoshaphat's in. But before anybody marches anywhere, he has one request for Ahab.

cards.question: Before they march, Jehoshaphat asks Ahab, king of Israel, to inquire first for the ___ of the LORD.

cards.text: So Ahab gathers the prophets, four hundred men, and asks if they should go to war against Ramoth-gilead or refrain. Friend, I can't get FOUR people in a group chat to agree on a time, and this man is polling FOUR HUNDRED.

cards.question: True or false: the four hundred prophets tell Ahab not to go up to Ramoth-gilead.

cards.text: Four hundred prophets say go up, and Jehoshaphat asks, "Is there not still a prophet of the LORD here of whom we can inquire?" That's the shopper staring at a whole wall of shoes going, you got anything in the back?

cards.question: Ahab admits there's still one man they can inquire of the LORD through: Micaiah son of Imlah. Why does Ahab say he hates him?

answers.text: He never prophesies anything good for Ahab
He refuses to come whenever Ahab calls
He once insulted Ahab in front of Israel

cards.question: Ahab says he hates Micaiah. True or false: Jehoshaphat tells Ahab that the king should not say that.

cards.text: Ahab hates the one prophet who never tells him anything good, which is like deleting your weather app because it keeps saying RAIN. Still, he sends an official to bring Micaiah son of Imlah at once.

Both kings sit on their thrones in royal attire at the threshing floor by the gate of Samaria, with all the prophets prophesying in front of them. Then one of those prophets, Zedekiah son of Chenaanah, steps up with something he made for himself.

cards.question: What has Zedekiah son of Chenaanah made for himself?

cards.text: Zedekiah declares, "This is what the LORD says: 'With these you shall gore the Arameans until they are finished off.'" The man brought PROPS to a prophecy, and every other prophet there is saying the same thing: go up and triumph.
Meanwhile, the messenger who went to get Micaiah gives him a little coaching.

cards.question: What does the messenger ask Micaiah to do when he gets to the kings?

answers.text: Speak favorably like the other prophets
Stay silent in front of the kings
Tell Ahab to wait another year

cards.question: Micaiah answers the messenger with an oath: he will speak whatever ___ tells him.

cards.text: Micaiah arrives, and Ahab asks him the same question he asked the four hundred: should we go to war against Ramoth-gilead, or should we refrain? Everybody at that gate leans in.

cards.question: True or false: Micaiah's first answer to Ahab sounds just like the four hundred prophets.

cards.text: And Ahab fires back, "How many times must I make you swear not to tell me anything but the truth in the name of the LORD?" The ONE time the man finally hears a yes, and he sends it back to the kitchen like a burnt batch.

cards.question: So Micaiah tells Ahab what he saw. What picture does he give of all Israel?

answers.text: Scattered on the hills like sheep without a shepherd
Marching home with the spoils of the city
Standing guard along the walls of Samaria

cards.question: True or false: in Micaiah's vision, the LORD says, "These people have no master; let each one return home in peace."

cards.text: Ahab turns to Jehoshaphat: "Did I not tell you that he never prophesies good for me, but only bad?" But Micaiah keeps going: he saw the LORD sitting on His throne, with all the host of heaven standing on His right and on His left.

cards.question: In Micaiah's vision, the LORD asks who will entice Ahab king of Israel to march up and ___ at Ramoth-gilead.

cards.text: One suggests this, another that, until a spirit comes forward, stands before the LORD, and says, "I will entice him." The LORD asks, "By what means?"

cards.question: In Micaiah's vision, the spirit says it will entice Ahab by being a ___ spirit in the mouths of all Ahab's prophets.

cards.text: The LORD tells the spirit it will surely entice him and prevail, and to go and do it. Then Micaiah brings it home: the LORD has put a lying spirit in the mouths of these prophets of Ahab's, and the LORD has pronounced disaster against him.
Then Zedekiah, the prophet with the iron horns, goes up and strikes Micaiah in the face.

cards.question: After striking Micaiah, what does Zedekiah demand to know?

answers.text: Which way the Spirit of the LORD went to reach Micaiah
Who gave Micaiah the right to speak to the king
Why Micaiah dared to stand before the two kings

cards.question: Micaiah tells Zedekiah he'll soon see, on the day he goes and hides. Where does Micaiah say he'll hide?

cards.text: Then Ahab gives his orders: take Micaiah back to Amon, the governor of the city, and to Joash, the king's son (not the later King Joash of Judah).

cards.question: Ahab orders Micaiah put in prison until Ahab returns safely. True or false: Ahab also orders that Micaiah be fed well while he waits.
Ahab says Micaiah stays locked up until Ahab returns safely. What does Micaiah say back about that?

answers.text: If you return safely the LORD has not spoken through me
You will return safely but your army will not
The LORD will bring you home before evening

cards.text: Then Micaiah adds one more line for everybody listening: "Take heed, all you people!"
So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah go up to Ramoth-gilead. And Ahab has an idea for the battle.

cards.question: What does Ahab, the king of Israel, tell Jehoshaphat about how they'll go into battle?

answers.text: I'll disguise myself and you wear your royal robes
You lead the charge while I guard the camp
We'll both disguise ourselves as common soldiers

cards.text: So Ahab goes in disguised, while Jehoshaphat is out there in the ROYAL ROBES. One king is blending in, and the other is dressed like the MAIN EVENT.

cards.question: Over on the other side, the king of Aram, the nation they're fighting, orders his chariot commanders to fight no one, small or great, except the king of ___.

cards.text: The chariot commanders spot Jehoshaphat in his royal robes and say, "This is the king of Israel!" They turn to fight him, and friend, those robes are working GREAT, just on the wrong guy.

cards.question: With the chariot commanders turning on him, what happens to Jehoshaphat?

answers.text: He cries out and the LORD helps him
He throws off his royal robes and runs
He hides behind the chariot of Ahab

cards.question: True or false: once the chariot commanders see that Jehoshaphat isn't the king of Israel, they keep chasing him anyway.

cards.text: Meanwhile Ahab is out there in disguise, blending in. Then a certain man draws his bow without taking special aim, and he strikes the king of Israel between the joints of his armor.

cards.question: Badly wounded, what does Ahab, the king of Israel, tell his charioteer?

answers.text: Turn around and take me out of the battle
Drive me straight toward the king of Aram
Go find Jehoshaphat and bring him here

cards.question: The battle rages all day, and the king of Israel props himself up in his chariot facing the Arameans until evening. True or false: at sunset, the king of Israel dies.

cards.text: That's where we'll set this batch down for now. Trust me, friend, Jehoshaphat's story is still in the oven.
